properties.name: Official C&C Character Creation Wizard
properties.author: The Kraken
properties.description: A guided character builder for Castles & Crusades on the official CnCRPG ruleset. Abilities - Race - Class - Primes - Hit Points - Equipment - Spells - Finish. The Castle Keeper sets the starting level in Options (Character Wizard); the wizard builds the character at that level. Reads the official C&C Player's Handbook and the other official books you load.

announcement.text: Official C&C Character Creation Wizard 1.0-beta1: open Characters and click the wizard figure to build a character.
